t: Prosecutors say they'll drop charges in Dani deer case
s: February 7, 2013 - The Councellers rescued an injured fawn in 2010 and nursed it back to health, naming it Dani. They kept it in a pen on their 17-acre farm for nearly two years and said they had the intention of releasing it back into the wild when they felt it was big enough and strong enough. A state conservation officer learned last summer that the Councellers had the deer in their possession and sought to have it killed.
